headline: Service Desk Analyst II — IT support, Citrix/VDI, 1,000+ users
experience_summary: I'm a Service Desk Analyst II at Matrix Global Services, providing remote technical support to 1,000+ end users since April 2023. I deliver first-line support for Citrix/VDI desktops and standard applications (Microsoft Office, iManage), prioritize and resolve requests through an ITSM ticketing system, and escalate to second- and third-level support when needed. I troubleshoot hardware and software issues, handle software and peripheral installs, help maintain network and server infrastructure, and collaborate with other IT teams to reduce downtime and improve system performance. Earlier, through the Google x Multiverse apprenticeship, I provided technical support to Google employees via chat, call, and ticket, provisioned security keys with SMEs, and earned the Google IT Support Professional Certificate.
